title: Archive of tiger mosquito colonisation data in France
description: Automatic archive of GeoJSON snapshots of tiger mosquito (Aedes albopictus) colonisation data displayed by the ANSES online map for France. Each release contains a dated snapshot; per-snapshot metadata is stored in metadata.json inside the release archive.
notes: The archive metadata and packaging are provided under CC BY 4.0. The original upstream ANSES data does not have a clearly defined license; users should consult the source legal notice before reuse.
